comment: Real-markdown regression corpus (spec kami-v0.3-hardening §7). markerDensity = bytes covered by MARKER-kind segments ÷ total bytes, measured with the engine (default options). Entries marked structured:synthetic carry real prose with mechanically added markdown scaffolding. This manifest is documentation and the licensing record; tests iterate corpora/*.md directly and never parse this file.

documents.notes: RTL coverage; real Arabic prose, mechanically added headings/quotes/nested lists (≥4-level nesting probe); no real permissive Arabic markdown was found

ZWJ families, skin tones, tag-sequence flags, keycaps, VS16 — every class placed flush against delimiters; 4-level list nesting. Deliberately excludes a keycap whose base char doubles as a delimiter, and VS15 text-presentation forms (both are confirmed AppKit divergences — PLATFORM_BUGS.md #4)
adds what ar-albukhala-structured.md (Arabic-only RTL) lacks: mixed-direction inline runs, Thaana, and Hebrew alongside Latin
fenced code blocks across varied info-string languages; markers are the fence delimiters
long footnote definitions and references; low marker density prose
